title: Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan graces Ruby and Silver Jubilee Valedictory Celebrations of SASTRA Deemed University, Thanjavur
subtitle:
NEP 2020 is a Guiding Pillar for Educational Progress from KG to Ph.D.: Vice President
Public Examination Reform Reflects Government’s Commitment to a Fair and Transparent System for India’s Youth: Vice President
India’s Higher Education Gross Enrolment Ratio Expected to Rise from 30% to 50% by 2035: Vice President
SASTRA-Tata Communications Partnership in Cybersecurity and Networking Relevant to India’s Sovereign Growth: Vice President
“Time is Precious; Focus on Innovation and Skill Upgradation and Restrict Social Media Usage”: Vice President
body_text:
Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan today graced the Ruby and Silver Jubilee Valedictory Celebrations of SASTRA Deemed University at its campus in Thanjavur and congratulated the University on completing important milestones in its journey of academic excellence.
Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan graced the Ruby and Silver Jubilee Valedictory Celebrations of SASTRA Deemed University today in Thanjavur. The Vice President described SASTRA as one of Tamil Nadu’s leading higher education institutions and appreciated its contribution… pic.twitter.com/d3OlQTigAb — Vice-President of India (@VPIndia) August 17, 2026
SASTRA.AI
Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan wished SASTRA continued success in all its endeavours and expressed confidence that it would grow further as a “temple of learning and excellence”, contributing to the ideals of Viksit Bharat @2047. Governor of Tamil Nadu and Keralam Shri Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar; SASTRA University Chancellor Prof. R. Sethuraman; Vice-Chancellor Prof. S. Vaidhyasubramaniam; Dean Prof. S. Swaminathan; and Registrar Prof. R. Chandramouli, faculties, parents , students were present on the occasion.

enrichment.summary: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan attended the Ruby and Silver Jubilee Valedictory Celebrations of SASTRA Deemed University in Thanjavur, praising its academic contributions and reiterating that NEP 2020 guides education from KG to Ph.D. He noted India's higher education Gross Enrolment Ratio is expected to rise from 30% to 50% by 2035 and highlighted SASTRA's cybersecurity partnership with Tata Communications. He also advised students to focus on innovation and skill development while limiting social media use.
enrichment.context: This is a ceremonial address by the Vice President at a university anniversary event, containing general remarks on NEP 2020, higher education expansion targets, and exam reform rather than any new policy announcement. Such statements are routine at institutional events and reiterate existing government commitments rather than introducing new schemes or data. The GER figure and NEP references are reaffirmations of known national targets already part of the current affairs landscape.
